# RTK - Rust Token Killer (Codex CLI)

**Usage**: Token-optimized CLI proxy for shell commands.

## Rule

Always prefix shell commands with `rtk`.

Examples:

```bash
rtk git status
rtk cargo test
rtk npm run build
rtk pytest -q
```

## Meta Commands

```bash
rtk gain            # Token savings analytics
rtk gain --history  # Recent command savings history
rtk proxy <cmd>     # Run raw command without filtering
```

## Verification

```bash
rtk --version
rtk gain
which rtk
```

library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- data.frame(b = c(0, 1.5, 3), mse = c(9, 2.25, 0))

caption_text <- paste0(
  "Three recorded corrections evaluated on the same five synthetic observations used to determine the correction.\n",
  "No stochastic repetitions or held-out evaluation."
)

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = b, y = mse)) +
  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.2,
    stroke = 0.6,
    fill = "#0072B2",
    colour = "#004A73",
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = mse + 0.45),
    label = c("(0, 9)", "(1.5, 2.25)", "(3, 0)"),
    family = "sans",
    fontface = "plain",
    size = 12 / (72.27 / 25.4),
    colour = "#1F2937",
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 1.5, 3),
    labels = c("0", "1.5", "3"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 2.25, 4.5, 6.75, 9),
    labels = c("0", "2.25", "4.5", "6.75", "9"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-0.35, 3.35),
    ylim = c(-0.6, 10.2),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Recorded Mean Squared Error at Three Intercept Corrections",
    x = "Added intercept correction b",
    y = "Mean squared error",
    caption = caption_text
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "sans", base_size = 11) +
  theme(
